metadata.title: मिज़ोरम में सबसे आगे ZPM की कहानी | The story of ZPM in Mizoram elections
metadata.description:
Mizoram is set to hold assembly elections tomorrow, where the political landscape has seen significant shifts in recent years. Traditionally, the main contenders were the Mizo National Front (MNF) and the Congress party, which have dominated the state's politics for a long time. However, in 2017, a new regional party emerged and quickly rose to prominence, becoming the primary opposition to the MNF in the 2018 state elections.

This new regional party has steadily gained momentum and is now considered a serious contender for power in Mizoram. Political experts and analysts anticipate a closely contested election, with the regional party challenging the established MNF and Congress, potentially reshaping the political landscape in the state. This shift underscores the dynamic nature of Mizoram's politics, and the upcoming election will be closely watched to see how it all unfolds.
